task: optical+SAR WorldCover-consistent land-cover semantic segmentation under controlled registration error
dataset: SEN12TS WorldCover 3-region successor, 11 native classes, 1200 parent objects; literature references use WHU-OPT-SAR as same-type context
split: PRQ4 parent-first train/validation; sealed test excluded; literature split details remain source-specific
evaluation_protocol: pixel-wise semantic segmentation with mIoU as primary metric; OA/accuracy are secondary context; no test access

metrics.name: mIoU
metrics.comparability_notes: Weighted distribution of conventional full-fusion rows from same-type optical-SAR dense segmentation papers. Three high-comparability WHU full-modality sources are included, but exact SEN12TS 11-class/CROMA preprocessing is not represented; this band is a literature prior, not a transferred scientific result.

metrics.name: OA
metrics.comparability_notes: Secondary OA context only; source splits and label taxonomies differ, so baseline reproduction must report OA on the frozen SEN12TS validation evaluator.

notes: No PRQ4 baseline result is present yet. External values are reference evidence only; they do not establish an SEN12TS result or innovation claim.
